priority_items.title: Vanuatu PM cancels UNGA as MV Matui search continues; VMSA pulled under PMO
priority_items.summary: MV Matui sank 11 Sep between Santo and Ambae. As of 15 Sep: 2 confirmed dead, 14 survivors, ~30+ missing; passenger counts disputed. Napat cancelled UNGA-81 trip and took VMSA oversight from the maritime ministry. Daily Post/RNZ: vessel allegedly deregistered in June.

priority_items.title: Bougainville Panguna camp arson; Toroama guarantees investor security
priority_items.summary: Armed group burned Lloyds Metals equipment at Panguna on 13 Sep. Toroama (15 Sep) said work continues and police will protect partners. Landowners council apologised. OCCRP claim of two shot / seven arrested is uncorroborated by PINA/PMN.

priority_items.title: US Landau tour: COFA reconstruction intent, Peace Corps return to Solomon Islands, MCC studies
priority_items.summary: State (11 Sep) / PINA (14 Sep): >US$100m FSM Sinlaku reconstruction intent under COFA; Peace Corps return agreement with SLB; four ARFF vehicles for Honiara Airport; MCC Parliament assessment; MCC Kiritimati wharf study. PINA US$150m roll-up is an official aggregation, not an appropriation.

priority_items.title: Fiji declares HIV epidemic a national emergency
priority_items.summary: Health Minister Lalabalavu (15 Sep): outbreak-level response insufficient; 1 in 60 adults estimated living with HIV vs 1 in 167 five years ago. Needle-and-syringe programme to be mobilised; Cabinet sub-committee of five. Cabinet had used 'national crisis under emergency powers' language on 9–10 Sep.

priority_items.title: Australia Hunter-class ~A$27bn for first three ships; UK pitches hybrid navy to NZ
priority_items.summary: ABC: budget documents allocate close to A$27bn to first three Hunter frigates. Conroy has previously treated remaining spend vs Mogami/autonomous as an open option. Newsroom: RN Fleet Commander Moorhouse pitched crewed+uncrewed mix to NZ; argued against a frigate-less fleet. AUKUS fifth-anniversary copy is analysis, not an operational milestone.
